run_colmap_export: run MapAnything inference on images and export results to COLMAP format with sparse reconstruction
run_colmap_with_glb: run MapAnything inference and export COLMAP format plus a dense mesh GLB file
run_colmap_apache_model: run MapAnything COLMAP export using the Apache 2.0 licensed model variant
run_colmap_explicit_voxel: run MapAnything COLMAP export with an explicit voxel size in meters
run_colmap_skip_point2d: run MapAnything COLMAP export skipping Point2D backprojection for faster processing
